topic: Analytics issues with facility data and demographics
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered two main analytics topics. First, a discussion point regarding report problems with visit frequency was raised (DOOH-1919). A second major issue involved data gaps at Company 7847, where many virtual facilities linked to real ones suffered from low session counts due to old sensor technology, causing forecast models to fail and reporting zero sessions for many facilities. It was proposed that an algorithm could be developed to 'backfill' or 'upscale' the forecast sessions based on data from a previous full week.

Separately, it was noted that analytics for mall/airport locations were not displaying the required demographics provider, leading to inaccurate demographic data compared to traffic dashboards and campaign reports. This issue needs fixing, particularly because Brazilian airport data requires accurate demographics.
decisions: The visit frequency report problem (DOOH-1919) will be left as is for now.
An algorithm to backfill forecast sessions based on a previous full week's data will be investigated.
action_items: Someone needs to discuss the facility/session forecasting issue with Halyna and follow up by Tuesday.
Fix the demographic provider display in mall/airport analytics for accurate reporting, especially for Brazilian airports.
